uncertainty.coder_notes: Mode scoped_category applied. PRE was a flat label list; POST is detailed personas plus a B2B segment plus a model-choice note. Many-to-many mapping was required: Fashion Enthusiasts and Young Professionals both track most plausibly to The Urban Creative; pairing one-to-one is not defensible because each PRE label has only a partial successor. Reframed was selected for the Fashion Enthusiasts and Art Connoisseurs pairs, with Expanded reserved for the clear broadening of Young Professionals into the urban creative profile. Boundary_case_elab_vs_reframe flagged for the Art Connoisseurs and Fashion Enthusiasts transitions, where narrowing vs reframing was arguable.
